title: Legal Basement Apartments
shortDescription: Convert your basement into a fully permitted, code-compliant second suite that generates rental income and increases your property value.
fullDescription: A legal basement apartment is one of the smartest investments a homeowner in London, Ontario can make. With rising housing costs and strong rental demand, a properly permitted second suite can generate $1,200–$2,000+ in monthly rental income while adding significant value to your property. Our team handles every aspect of the conversion — from initial feasibility assessment and architectural drawings to permit applications, construction, and final inspection. We ensure your second suite meets all Ontario Building Code requirements including separate entrances, fire separations, egress windows, ceiling heights, plumbing, electrical, and HVAC. Whether you’re converting an existing finished basement or starting from scratch, we make the process straightforward and stress-free.
features: Full permit handling and municipal approvals
Fire separation and smoke alarm systems

title: Basement Underpinning
shortDescription: Increase your basement ceiling height by lowering the floor — essential for meeting building code requirements and creating livable space.
fullDescription: Many older homes in London have basements with ceiling heights under 6’9”, which doesn’t meet Ontario Building Code minimums for habitable space. Basement underpinning lowers the existing foundation and floor to create the ceiling height you need — typically 8’ or more. This is a specialized structural process that involves excavating beneath the existing footings in carefully sequenced sections, pouring new concrete to extend the foundation depth, and then pouring a new floor slab. Our team has extensive experience with underpinning London’s older housing stock, including homes with stone, block, and poured concrete foundations. Every project is engineered by a licensed structural engineer and inspected at every stage.

title: Basement Waterproofing
shortDescription: Eliminate moisture, leaks, and flooding with interior and exterior waterproofing solutions that keep your basement dry year-round.
fullDescription: Water intrusion is the number one enemy of basement living space. Whether you’re dealing with seasonal dampness, foundation cracks, or active leaks, our comprehensive waterproofing solutions address the problem at its source. We offer both interior and exterior waterproofing systems including interior weeping tile and sump pump installation, exterior foundation membrane application, crack injection, French drain systems, and grading corrections. Every waterproofing project starts with a thorough moisture assessment to identify exactly where and why water is entering your basement. We then recommend the most effective and cost-efficient solution for your specific situation. All waterproofing work comes with our transferable warranty for lasting peace of mind.
features: Weeping tile and sump pump systems

title: Basement Finishing & Renovation
shortDescription: Transform your unfinished or outdated basement into beautiful living space — family rooms, home offices, gyms, media rooms, and more.
fullDescription: Your basement represents up to 40% of your home’s total square footage — don’t let it go to waste. Our basement finishing service transforms raw or outdated lower levels into comfortable, functional living space tailored to your lifestyle. From open-concept family rooms and home theatres to dedicated home offices, gyms, and guest suites, we design and build basements that feel like a natural extension of your home. Every project includes proper insulation, vapour barrier, moisture management, electrical, lighting design, flooring, and finishing. We handle everything from framing to final paint so you get a turnkey result with zero hassle.
features: Luxury vinyl plank and tile flooring

title: Egress Windows & Emergency Exits
shortDescription: Install code-compliant egress windows that provide natural light, ventilation, and safe emergency exits for basement bedrooms.
fullDescription: Ontario Building Code requires every basement bedroom to have an egress window — a window large enough for a person to escape through in an emergency. Egress windows are also one of the best upgrades you can make to any basement space because they flood the room with natural light and make the space feel open and above-grade. Our installation process includes cutting through the foundation wall, excavating a window well, installing a properly sized window unit, waterproofing the opening, and building a code-compliant window well with a cover and ladder if the well depth requires it. The result is a brighter, safer, and more valuable basement.

title: Basement Bathroom Installation
shortDescription: Add a full or half bathroom to your basement with proper plumbing, drainage, and ventilation — essential for legal suites and comfortable living.
fullDescription: A basement bathroom is essential for any legal second suite and dramatically increases the functionality of finished basement space. Whether you need a full bathroom with shower or tub, a three-piece ensuite, or a simple half-bath, our team handles the complete installation including rough-in plumbing, drainage connections, sewage ejector pumps where needed, waterproofing, tiling, fixtures, and ventilation. We work with your existing plumbing stack and drainage to minimize disruption and cost. Every bathroom is designed to maximize the available space while meeting all building code requirements for ventilation, waterproofing, and accessibility.

title: Foundation Repair
shortDescription: Fix cracks, bowing walls, settling, and structural damage to protect your home’s integrity and prevent costly future problems.
fullDescription: Foundation problems don’t fix themselves — they get worse and more expensive over time. Whether you’re seeing horizontal or stair-step cracks, bowing basement walls, water seepage through the foundation, or uneven floors above, early intervention saves money and prevents structural failure. We provide comprehensive foundation repair services including crack injection with epoxy or polyurethane, carbon fibre reinforcement for bowing walls, steel beam installation, helical pier underpinning for settling foundations, and complete foundation wall replacement when necessary. Every repair is designed by a structural engineer and comes with a warranty.
